tutorial_move: Select a unit, then click a blue highlighted tile to move.
tutorial_attack: Select a unit, click Attack, then target an enemy in the red range.
tutorial_cover: Stay near crates or walls to gain cover and reduce enemy hit chance.
tutorial_evac: Move to the green evac zone to complete the objective.
tutorial_overwatch: Overwatch lets the unit auto-attack enemies entering range.
tutorial_skill: Skills cost AP and have cooldowns. Use them wisely.
tutorial_item: Items can heal or support units. Watch your supply.
tutorial_highground: High ground grants bonus hit and crit chance.
tutorial_interact: Move near interactive objects to use skills or devices.
